Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

package slidingwindow;

public class MaxSumOfSubArray {
    private int maxSubArraySum(int[] nums, int k){
        int windowSum = 0;
        int maxSum = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        int i = 0;
        for(int j = 0; j < nums.length; j++){
            windowSum += nums[j];
            if(j >= k - 1){
                maxSum = Math.max(windowSum, maxSum);
                windowSum -= nums[i++];
            }
        }
        return maxSum;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        MaxSumOfSubArray obj = new MaxSumOfSubArray();
        int[] nums = {1, 3, -1, -3, 5, 3, 6, 7};
        int k = 3;
        System.out.println(obj.maxSubArraySum(nums, k));
    }
}
